answer: The vine graph is validated at intake and the comet frontier is published, so that the ancestry of every answer is public, and spiral anchors the chain at a checkpoint. A freshly minted alias has no ancestry, so it must first attach itself to real accepted work: 207 new identities mean that many orphan roots to graft by hand rather than print, and each root still needs its own identity record. A 323 account operation therefore ties up 17 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
